body.line1: This project has joined a broader initiative. The StableCoin Stack Foundation spec is now hosted under
body.line2: — a unified umbrella advancing open standards for the future of digital payments.

body.p1: The StableCoin Stack Foundation (SSF) specification you know hasn't changed — it's simply been brought into the Fabric Payment Standards umbrella to align with a wider ecosystem of open payment protocols.
body.p2: All previous links, documentation, and references to stablecoinstack.org should be updated to point to the new URL. This page will remain active as a permanent redirect.

spec.title: Specification unchanged
spec.desc: The SSF spec content, versioning, and structure remain exactly as they were.
